reconstructed_captions.24: A person strikes a ferro rod, sending a shower of sparks into the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.25: The sparks land on the dry grass tinder, which begins to smolder.
reconstructed_captions.26: The person gently blows on the smoldering tinder to encourage a flame.
reconstructed_captions.27: A small flame erupts from the center of the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.28: The person carefully places the flaming tinder bundle onto the prepared kindling.
reconstructed_captions.29: The small flames begin to catch on the wood shavings and tiny twigs.
reconstructed_captions.30: The person gently blows on the base of the fire to help it spread.
reconstructed_captions.31: The kindling is now alight, and the fire is starting to establish itself.
reconstructed_captions.32: The person carefully adds more small pieces of split wood to the growing flames.
reconstructed_captions.33: Smoke billows from the small fire as the flames grow stronger.
reconstructed_captions.34: The small campfire is now burning on its own, with a bed of embers forming.
reconstructed_captions.35: A view of the small, smoky fire burning on the log platform by the creek.
